Tax year: 2024/2025 | 6 April 2024 - 5 April 2025 | Currency: GBP

This report covers the tax year from 06 April 2024 to 05 April 2025.
If you are the beneficial owner of more than one account, separate reports will be provided for each account. As a
result, capital gains and losses are calculated separately for each account. Positions in the same investment held in
different accounts are not consolidated.
The report reflects the tax treatment applicable to a UK resident individual and follows HMRC guidance. Chargeable
capital gains arising during the relevant tax year on the disposal of securities are matched using the Section 104
holding rules. Income and expenses associated with the fund are treated as reportable income where applicable.
